design.vocab_derivation: slot-wise: token = code + p*stride + 1, vocab = stride*L + 1 = 256*6 + 1; see docs/SID_FORMAT.md

sk_epsilons.rule_adopted: epsilon on the LAST level only
sk_epsilons.rationale: This is the only rule that directly generalises the recovered historical pattern. History places the stochastic-quantisation epsilon on the final residual level ([0,0,0.003] for depth 3), not on level 3 as a fixed index. Option A carries that rule to depth 5 unchanged. Options B ([0,0,0,0.003,0.003]) and C (all zeros) have no historical basis and were rejected.
sk_epsilons.status: ADOPTED -- recorded in the experiment decision log (not shipped) as the recommended option; no sweep performed

embedding_source.note: identical to the historical RQ-VAE runs; in_dim is read from the parquet

random_seed.tokenizer_seed_source: hard-coded in rqvae/main.py (`seed = 2024`), applied to random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
random_seed.note: The two stages use different seeds historically. Both are recorded as recovered facts and neither was changed.

sid_generation.mechanics: loads best_collision_model.pth, decodes every item to its 5 residual codes, detects duplicate full-prefix groups (check_collision / get_collision_item) and appends one disambiguation index per item
sid_generation.item_row_alignment: row i of the SID array is dataset item id i+1 (docs/ITEM_ID_CONVENTION.md); canonicalise on load

collision_token.entry_point: rqvae/append_collision_token.py (or the equivalent in-block path inside generate_code.py)
collision_token.construction: group items by their full 5-token semantic prefix; within each group assign each item a distinct index 0..(group_size-1) as the 6th position
collision_token.hard_failure_rule: raises if the largest duplicate group exceeds codebook_size, because a single disambiguation token would then be insufficient
collision_token.injectivity_requirement: item -> full 6-token SID must be 100 % injective; verified in the corresponding stage

applicability.codebook_sweep: NOT part of this recipe file; the corresponding stage trains Beauty-only variants with only codebook_size changed, and derives vocab dynamically per the corresponding stage

note: canonical RQ-VAE5 recipe (hyper-parameters only). The RQ-VAE tokenizer implementation is not bundled in this release; build the tokenizer/SID array with an external RQ-VAE implementation (see README section 5.2) and use these exact hyper-parameters.
